statement.notes: Mapping Notes: 1) 'advance_payments_for_purchases' not found; field set to null. 2) 'cash' mapped to 'Cash and cash equivalents' only; excludes 'Restricted cash' and 'Term deposits'. 3) 'investment_in_securities' calculated as sum of: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss (both current and non-current), Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income (both current and non-current), and Other financial assets (both current and non-current). Does not include 'Investments in associates', 'Investments in joint ventures', or 'Term deposits'. 4) 'accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities' calculated as sum of 'Accounts payable' and 'Other payables and accruals'. 5) 'advance_payments_from_sales' calculated as sum of non-current and current 'Deferred revenue'.
